UNDERSTAND THE PRODUCT

Product description

White onion planting seed for fresh-market and processing onion crops. Onion seeds are planting seeds for onion crop production. Buyers should specify the variety and required bulb characteristics, together with seed testing and treatment requirements. This is an agricultural planting product, separate from culinary spices.

For planting use. Confirm variety, growing conditions, treatment and destination seed documentation before ordering.

Common applications

Onion crop production; agricultural seed supply.

Specification status

Product form, quality limits, availability and lot test results are agreed with the final offer.

PRACTICAL BUYING DETAILS

Before you choose a lot.

Match the product, specification and commercial terms.

Product questions

What should I send for a white onion seeds enquiry?

Tell us the variety, quantity, packing, destination country and the germination, purity and treatment requirements of your country. We confirm the seed lot, documents and price in the quotation.

Are onion seeds the same as kalonji?

No. Onion seeds are planting seed for growing onions. Kalonji (nigella) is a spice that is sometimes sold as "black onion seed". We supply both; please say which one you need.

Packing, storage & shelf life

Tell us the packing format and net weight you require. Bag construction, liner, labelling and pallet requirements are agreed with the offer. Confirm the lot’s storage conditions, shelf life or relevant dates rather than assuming a standard duration.

For food ingredients, agree the intended use, required testing and offered lot’s handling instructions.
